decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-77 MODIFY recording detailed shot descriptions, optional online example frames, and an updated storyboard reel as an alternative; no additional change is required.
The candidate already has a complete message-77 MODIFY applying the revised shot-specification method to SQ11.

Message 75 establishes that the specification process applies to every storyboard mismatch, and message 77 changes that process to detailed descriptions with optional example frames while retaining an updated reel as an alternative; SQ12 is an unresolved storyboard-mismatch scene and lacks this update.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Because I’m not good at updating the storyboard reel yet and doing so takes me too long, I’d prefer to try more detailed shot descriptions, possibly supported by example frames I find online. Updating the reel myself remains an option as well.

value_updates.shot_specification_method: Detailed shot descriptions, possibly supported by online example frames; an updated storyboard reel remains an optional specification method.

decisions.reason: The source changes how storyboard mismatches and shot directions are communicated, not the required appearance or behavior of the SQ4 energy blast.
Optional reference frames for communicating shot directions do not change the independent requirements governing set-image quality or generation of new set images.
The revised shot-specification method does not alter the final video's full-color requirement.
The revised shot-specification method does not alter the required 9:16 vertical output format.
The source changes the medium used to communicate mismatched shot directions but does not change the established wide-to-mid-to-closer framing progression.
The use of detailed shot descriptions or reference frames does not change the requirement that new sets remain stylistically consistent across shots.
The source does not change the requirement that revised sets remain visually distinct from one another.
The source does not change the existence, composition, priority, or deferred lifecycle of the opening aerial establishing shot.
The revised shot-description process does not alter which bridges must be removed or retained in the Kestrel images.
